findings.issue: AC4 scenario title says BR1 to BR9 but its body and the rule table cover BR1 to BR18. TC-E7-001-08 also says BR1 to BR9.
AC5 expects 401 and 404 answers, but the error-status line calls 401 and 404 Not specified. The story contradicts itself.
Error-status to message binding (400/422 to MSG-GEN-001, 403 to MSG-P4-002, 503 to MSG-P7-003) is not in any source. MSG-P7-003 is the decision-record message, not a 503.
Text says R-DEV-21 is carried as the BR6 unmapped-code route, but no R-DEV-21 row exists and the BR6 mapping is not sourced.
TC-E7-001-06 cites ASM-3438, which no source or disposition supports.
Step 8 says the queue is served by the case list. Neither the sources nor the dispositions say this; the route is still pending owner confirmation.
Legacy table Feature column 'Run X1 dispute and complaint end to end' is not in any disposition or source; treat as unverified.
Contract version row gives path /api/recovery/deviation/v1, which no source or disposition states; only the /v1 version is sourced.
